clips.title: The story
paras: A giant foreststrider carries the Top of Gelkak's Key into the woods near Darkshore. It is one of three broken pieces of a mechanical key belonging to the shipwrecked gnome Gelkak Gyromast.

Threshadons attacked Gelkak Gyromast's ship off Darkshore and sent it beneath the waves. The gnome washed ashore with the winding key for his mechanical first mate. The impact against the coastal rocks broke it into three pieces. Before the dizzy pirate could gather his wits, beasts scavenged the wreckage. A giant foreststrider carried the ornate upper piece into the woods.
